page_title: WHU 3-2 BUR | West Ham v Burnley 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Burnley players have a reason to celebrate!
90+8' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Burnley goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90+7' 3 - 2 Goal! Josh Cullen (Burnley) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:2.
90+6' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.

90+4' Close effort! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

90+4' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Burnley, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+2' The ball goes behind for a corner. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+2' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) produces a shot on goal from a mid-range free kick. It heads towards the top right corner, but the keeper averts the danger with a stunning save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Burnley.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alphonse Areola shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
87' 3 - 1 Goal! Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:1.
86' Kyle Walker (Burnley) picks up a yellow card.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) is coming onto the pitch as Crysencio Summerville cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Here comes a substitution. Igor (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Paqueta.
81' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Quilindschy Hartman will be replaced by Lucas Pires (Burnley).
81' The substitution is prepared. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jaidon Anthony.
79' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Alphonse Areola (West Ham) leaps to collect the ball.
79' Michael Salisbury interrupts the game. One of the players from West Ham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

77' 2 - 1 The ball finds its way to Tomas Soucek (West Ham) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:1.
77' The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

76' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
74' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
73' Kyle Walker (Burnley) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
73' The ratio of the ball possession is 44:56.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) will replace Lesley Ugochukwu.
71' Scott Parker has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armando Broja (Burnley) replacing Zian Flemming.
71' Today's match ends for Callum Wilson who will be replaced by Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham).
71' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) but poses no threat.

70' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
67' The ball goes out of play and West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
67' It is time for a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is on for Loum Tchaouna.
66' The cross into the penalty area from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
62' Problems for Nuno Espirito Santo as Freddie Potts (West Ham) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Tomas Soucek replaces him.
59' Freddie Potts (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' Zian Flemming (Burnley) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
57' The ball is cleared after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
55' Zian Flemming (Burnley) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Salisbury didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
55' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Kyle Walker (Burnley) produces a long-range pass.
51' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from West Ham was in an offside position.
48' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+1' Michael Salisbury sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+1' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Callum Wilson (West Ham) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
44' The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
43' West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing.
41' West Ham players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
38' The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
38' A snap shot by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
35' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Zian Flemming (Burnley) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header inside the right post.
34' Kyle Walker (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
33' The West Ham players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
33' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) and Lucas Paqueta perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
30' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) and Jarrod Bowen combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
30' A player from Burnley commits a rough challenge. Michael Salisbury blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
28' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
26' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
25' The game is interrupted now, Florentino (Burnley) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
25' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
24' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) tries to find Jaidon Anthony, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
23' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' The players claim that Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
19' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
17' Great teamplay by Burnley as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) tries to find Zian Flemming, but he puts too much power on the pass.
13' Freddie Potts (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
13' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) finds Max Kilman with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
12' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
11' West Ham are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
10' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
8' West Ham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
3' Kyle Walker (Burnley) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
2' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has started.
West Ham will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Salisbury.
